supplemental_witnesses.identity_status: unresolved; no registrations or CISI identifiers in source caption
supplemental_witnesses.visible_observation: Three separate clay fragments have impressed graphic panels. The published view shows stamped faces and broken edges; it does not supply reverse attachment surfaces.
supplemental_witnesses.caption_assertion: The excavators describe two different seal impressions on each object and tentatively suggest transported bundles and a nonlocal-looking clay.
supplemental_witnesses.scope: The clay-origin and transport interpretations require compositional and attachment evidence; no inferred target identity was entered.

supplemental_witnesses.identity_status: source registration confirmed; not matched to a target CISI number or normalized object
supplemental_witnesses.visible_observation: A separate rounded clay fragment carries a partial bordered animal-and-sign impression. Several surface striations are visible at a broken edge; their attachment origin is unresolved in this view.
supplemental_witnesses.caption_assertion: The source identifies low-fired terracotta from Trench 54 and interprets this sealing type as a closure for transported bundles.
supplemental_witnesses.scope: H-1724 is absent from the export, but the registration cannot be assigned to that number by elimination.

independent_context_limit: The generic operation labels come from the excavators' explicit object ranges. Only two targets gain individual published locus and lot/item keys from the inspected caption. Disposal fills do not identify the place where the vessels were used.
